newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire says another Shaba town threatened by rebels.
newsitem.headline: Zaire says another Shaba town threatened by rebels.

text.p: Zaire has rushed troops by air and rail to defend another town from rebels in the copper province of Shaba, a defence ministry official said in the capital Kinshasa on Tuesday.
He said rebels were trying to reach Moba, about 150 km (90 miles) from the more important Lake Tanganyika port of Kalemie, taken earlier by the guerrillas.

"The rebels are trying to get to Moba. They have taken, another route to the interior of Kalemie to get there but we have naval units there who will resist," said the official who asked not to be named. "We are sending in reinforcements by
train from the military bases in Kamina and Lubumbashi," he added.

Zaire earlier acknowledged more battlefield losses to Tutsi-led rebels who launched an armed campaign from Zaire's eastern borderlands in October. They now hold a 1,000 km (600 miles) strip stretching into the copper province.
